mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.4 percentage point or greater increase in the unemployment rate over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2% or greater decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over a 6-month period indicates weakening household demand, which reduces revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC drops below 0.01 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 1.5% or greater increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) over a 3-month window signals a supply-side expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 0.25% increase in FEDFUNDS and a 0.3 percentage point decrease in UNRATE over a 2-month window signals a restrictive monetary policy tightening coinciding with labor market softening, which reduces growth expectations and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% AND UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in 2 months
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market weakening
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC drops below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% or greater increase in the Housing Starts index (HOUST) over a 6-month window signals a residential construction boom, which boosts demand for materials and consumer goods and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point or greater increase in UNRATE over a 3-month window signals labor market tightening, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point or greater increase in FEDFUNDS over a 2-month window signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
